# WA Audio Stickers India

> Free, open-source (MIT) Chrome extension by Worklancio (India) that makes WhatsApp audio stickers, also called
> stickers with sound or sound stickers, from any video, GIF, photo or voice recording, and sends them from
> WhatsApp Web. Works in Chrome, Edge and Brave. Runs fully on the user's computer: no server, no sign-up, no
> tracking. Unofficial; not made by or affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta.

## Key facts
- Version 1.0.1, updated 2026-11-27. Price: free.
- Inputs: MP4, WebM, MOV, GIF, PNG, JPG, MP3, M4A, WAV, OGG; or record voice or webcam in the panel.
- Features: cut up to 15 seconds, speed 0.5x to 2x, boomerang, volume, auto level, fades, captions in Hindi,
  English or Hinglish, saved sticker library with pack export and import, app in Hindi and English.
- Output: animated WebP sticker plus Ogg Opus sound, each under WhatsApp's 1 MB limits.
- Permissions: storage and web.whatsapp.com only. Sends one sticker at a time, only when the user clicks.
- Made by Worklancio (https://www.worklancio.in), a web development company in India. Built by Harsh Prajapati.

## FAQ
- **What are WhatsApp audio stickers?** WhatsApp audio stickers (also called sound stickers) are animated stickers that play a short sound when you tap them. WA Audio Stickers India lets you make them from any video, GIF, photo or your own voice and send them from WhatsApp Web.
- **How do I send a sticker with sound on WhatsApp?** Install the free WA Audio Stickers India extension in Chrome, Edge or Brave, open web.whatsapp.com, click the lime tab, pick or record a clip, press Make sticker, then Send to this chat. Your friend taps the sticker and hears the sound.
- **Is WA Audio Stickers India free?** Yes. It is completely free and open source under the MIT licence, with no sign-up, no ads and no paid version.
- **Is it safe and private?** Yes. Everything is made on your own computer. The extension only asks for storage and web.whatsapp.com, has no server and no tracking, and sends only when you click, one sticker at a time.
- **Can I make audio stickers in Hindi?** Yes. You can add captions in Hindi, English or Hinglish, and the whole app can switch to Hindi with one tap.
- **Will my friend hear the sound?** Yes, if their WhatsApp is up to date. The sound plays on Android, iPhone and WhatsApp Web when they tap the sticker.
- **Does it work on my phone?** It runs on a computer, in WhatsApp Web. Use Send to myself, then forward or star the sticker from your phone to keep it in your sticker tray.
- **Is this an official WhatsApp tool?** No. It is an unofficial, open-source tool made by Worklancio in India. It is not made by, linked to or approved by WhatsApp or Meta.
